arm_notes.control: MatrixModel flatten_mlp 128, no workload: the same-family CUDA control (exact EXP-P35-001 DRAFT / EXP-P34-001 entry, runner requirement)
arm_notes.residual_counts: EXP-P32-001 arm unchanged (combo flag, model residual_mlp, frozen direct_residual_model.py, counts workload), old code path (direct_combo_model.build_combo / load_combo)
arm_notes.periodic_residual_counts: EXP-P32/P34/P35 arm unchanged (frozen PLR-lite embedding + residual backbone, blocks Dropout .1, counts workload), old code path; keeps its embed_residual flag, so the robust-clip family predicate is tested first in the runner and scorer
arm_notes.robust_clip_residual_counts: direct_robust_clip_model.DirectRobustClipResidualModel: frozen ResidualMLPNetwork constructor (same RNG draws, so for one seed every parameter equals the residual_counts initial value; only buffers are added), then per scalar x_j -> z/sqrt(1+(z/3)^2), z = s_j (x_j - median_j), s_j = 1/IQR_j else 2/range_j else 0, on 5 past positions x 8 physics channels (valid rows only) + the 41-column counts continuous map (the same list as periodic_residual_counts) = 81 scalars; frozen DirectResidualModel.fit
arm_notes.epoch_cap: Epoch cap 60, patience 5 for every arm (as EXP-P34-001 / EXP-P35-001). fit.json records cap, epochs_run, best_epoch and stopped_by per fit
arm_notes.statistics: Robust-scale statistics (median, scale) are computed in fit from the TRAIN argument only (never early-stop, temperature, blend, dev or mlb_dev rows), stored as buffers, hashed (rc_stats_sha256) and never recomputed at predict or load time. fit.json lifts rc_stats_sha256 and rc_rule_counts (re-derived from the fit report), rc_stats_rows (TRAIN-argument rows and per-past-position valid rows) and rc_module_sha256; the scorer requires ONE statistics hash, one TRAIN row hash and one record across all 5 robust-clip fits (same TRAIN => same statistics on every seed and GPU); load_model checks the archived statistics against the run-recorded hash
arm_notes.smoke_statistics: Smoke fits use the FIRST 8,192 TRAIN rows (runner SMOKE), so smoke statistics and their hash differ from the full run by design: smoke verifies wiring and identities only, never statistics or scores
arm_notes.not_faithful: Only the preprocessing step of RealMLP (Holzmueller, Grinsztajn, Steinwart NeurIPS 2024, arXiv:2407.04491v3 section 3); no learnable diagonal scaling layer, no NTP, not their MLP or hyperparameters; applied to our TRAIN mean/std standardized inputs (equivalent up to float32 rounding); our residual backbone, ten-class head, AdamW loop and calibration chain; no tuning; no claim that paper results transfer
arm_notes.module_pin: direct_robust_clip_model.py sha256 is pinned in ONE place, pitchmdp/direct_robust_clip_registry.py MODULE_SHA256 (author pin 5f1864b; re-pinned there after the module review disposition, before smoke); config_check, the factory and the runner fail closed if the file differs; the runner also records the actual sha in every task identity via MODEL_SOURCES and in fit.json rc_module_sha256
